say:1:1720928001:1.text: Paper, folks? Latest issue of Savannah Eye! Miss this one, and you'll regret it!
say:1:1720928001:1.source_cn: 几位顾客，要来份报纸吗！最新一期的《赛凡纳之眼》，不看...

choice_prompt:2:1720928001.text: Paper, folks? Latest issue of Savannah Eye! Miss this one, and you'll regret it!
choice_prompt:2:1720928001.source_cn: 几位顾客，要来份报纸吗！最新一期的《赛凡纳之眼》，不看简直是人生遗憾！

say:3:1720928002:1.text: I've got all the usual ones. The Savannah Morning Post, Savannah Daily, all that. But if you want the one everyone's buying, it's the Savannah Eye!
say:3:1720928002:1.source_cn: 我这里的报纸种类是最齐全的，什么《赛凡纳晨报》《每日赛...

choice_prompt:4:1720928002.text: I've got all the usual ones. The Savannah Morning Post, Savannah Daily, all that. But if you want the one everyone's buying, it's the Savannah Eye!
choice_prompt:4:1720928002.source_cn: 我这里的报纸种类是最齐全的，什么《赛凡纳晨报》《每日赛凡纳》都有，不过最推荐的，当然是《赛凡纳之眼》啦！

say:5:1720928003:1.text: W-What? Did I say something wrong? If you don't want that one, I've got others.
say:5:1720928003:1.source_cn: 怎、怎么啦？这位顾客，有什么问题吗？您要是不想看这些，...

choice_prompt:6:1720928003.text: W-What? Did I say something wrong? If you don't want that one, I've got others.
choice_prompt:6:1720928003.source_cn: 怎、怎么啦？这位顾客，有什么问题吗？您要是不想看这些，我还有别的！

say:7:1720928004:1.text: What? No! I'm just trying to make a little money. Why would I do that?
say:7:1720928004:1.source_cn: 您这说的是什么话！我只是赚点小钱而已，怎么可能干这种事！

say:8:1720928005:1.text: I'm only recommending it because it sells better than the others. That's all!
say:8:1720928005:1.source_cn: 我真的只是因为《赛凡纳之眼》卖得最好，才向你们推荐的！

say:9:1720928006:1.text: Now, now, kid. Spreading rumors can get you in serious trouble. I'm a reporter. I know how this works.
say:9:1720928006:1.source_cn: 哎呀，这位小朋友，传播谣言的后果可是很严重的！我就是记...

say:10:1720928007:1.text: And from what I've heard, the royal court is already furious about the rumors around Princess Peggy. They've started looking into who's been helping spread them!
say:10:1720928007:1.source_cn: 听说王室知道有人在坊间传播佩吉公主的流言，很不高兴，派...

say:11:1720928008:1.text: Y-You're bluffing! Besides, I'm not the only one selling it! And you're the ones coming at me with weird questions without even telling me who you are!
say:11:1720928008:1.source_cn: 我、我不信，又不是只有我一个人卖这份报，倒是你们，追着...

choice_prompt:12:1720928008.text: Y-You're bluffing! Besides, I'm not the only one selling it! And you're the ones coming at me with weird questions without even telling me who you are!
choice_prompt:12:1720928008.source_cn: 我、我不信，又不是只有我一个人卖这份报，倒是你们，追着我问这些奇怪的问题，又不说自己的身份，看起来很可疑！

say:13:1720928009:0.text: That's right. In this line of work, rivals are always at each other's throats! We're just digging into the competition and bringing the industry's dirty secrets to light!
say:13:1720928009:0.source_cn: 没错，同行是冤家！我们就是想查查竞争对手的底细，揭露业...

say:14:1720928010:0.text: Everything we uncover goes straight into my report for everyone to see, including whatever it is you're trying so hard to hide!
say:14:1720928010:0.source_cn: 调查到的一切，都会被我写进报道里，被所有人知道，包括你...

say:16:1720928013:1.text: But I swear, nobody paid me to spread lies!
say:16:1720928013:1.source_cn: 我发誓，我真的没有收钱散播假消息！

say:17:1720928014:1.text: You probably don't know this, but we work our tails off selling papers every day, and the publisher doesn't pay us a dime. It's the other way around—we have to buy the papers ourselves before we can sell them.
say:17:1720928014:1.source_cn: 你们可能不知道，我们每天辛辛苦苦地卖报纸，报社是不会付...

say:18:1720928015:1.text: So we do everything we can to sell every last copy. The ones that don't sell end up costing us!
say:18:1720928015:1.source_cn: 所以我们都很努力很努力地卖报纸！那些卖不掉的报纸真的很...

say:19:1720928016:1.text: A little while back, a friend told me about a paper that didn't make us pay up front. It was called the Savannah Eye. All we had to do was go to that place early every morning and pick up the copies.
say:19:1720928016:1.source_cn: 前不久，我的伙伴说，有一家不需要我们花钱进货的报纸！那...

say:20:1720928017:1.text: The place doesn't open until later in the day, so in the early morning it's completely empty. There's nobody there, just the papers. So we... we went there and took the copies we were going to sell. It's a secret only us newsboys know.
say:20:1720928017:1.source_cn: 那个地方下午才营业，清晨的时候空荡荡的，只有报纸放在那...

choice_prompt:21:1720928017.text: The place doesn't open until later in the day, so in the early morning it's completely empty. There's nobody there, just the papers. So we... we went there and took the copies we were going to sell. It's a secret only us newsboys know.
choice_prompt:21:1720928017.source_cn: 那个地方下午才营业，清晨的时候空荡荡的，只有报纸放在那里，于是我们就、就去进货了……这是只有我们报童才知道的秘密。

say:22:1720928018:1.text: But that's why people do it. If the papers don't cost us anything, then every coin we make is ours to keep. We earn more that way than we do on the other papers. We were just trying to make a little extra, that's all...
say:22:1720928018:1.source_cn: ……毕竟是不花钱的报纸，卖一个金币就有一个金币可赚，比...

say:23:1720928019:1.text: Anyway, that's all I know... I won't sell it anymore. I swear I wasn't trying to say anything bad about Princess Peggy...
say:23:1720928019:1.source_cn: 我知道的只有这么多了……我、我以后再也不卖《赛凡纳之眼...

say:24:1720928020:1.text: Where is it? The place where you pick up the papers?
say:24:1720928020:1.source_cn: 那个神秘的取报纸地点是在哪里？

say:25:1720928021:1.text: ... The <style="highlight">kitchen pass</style> behind the <style="highlight">Rusty Barrel Tavern</style>, down in the lower district. Early in the morning there's nobody there. Just stacks of papers. So we help ourselves...

say:26:1720928022:1.text: A tavern kitchen pass... Smart, I'll give them that. Come on. Let's take a look.
say:26:1720928022:1.source_cn: 酒馆的出餐口……真亏同行能想到这种地方。接下来我们就去...

choice:21:0:1.text: And you think that makes it okay?
choice:21:0:1.male: And you think that makes it okay?
choice:21:0:1.female: And you think that makes it okay?

choice:21:1:2.text: Doesn't sound very legitimate to me.
choice:21:1:2.male: Doesn't sound very legitimate to me.
choice:21:1:2.female: Doesn't sound very legitimate to me.

choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 我们是《赛凡纳之眼》的竞争对手

say:29:1720928011:1.text: That's right! The detective here is a friend of Master Rowan's! Princess Peggy's own fiancé asked us to look into this!
say:29:1720928011:1.male: That's right! The detective here is a friend of Master Rowan's! Princess Peggy's own fiancé asked us to look into this!
say:29:1720928011:1.female: That's right! The detective here is a friend of Master Rowan's! Princess Peggy's own fiancé asked us to look into this!

choice:12:1:2.female: We're here to investigate the rumors.
